name: Kimi wa Yoban me
source:
A young man named Shii woke up to find himself in a body he didn’t recognize.

According to the doctor, he is the fourth of several split personalities to form within this body.

Before the brain succumbs to the strain of housing these multiple identities—causing all of them to vanish forever—Shii is tasked with identifying the "original personality" so that he may eliminate the "fake" personalities, including himself.

Will Shii be able to restore the true personality to his body?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11869]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫四井的年轻人醒来后发现自己身处一具他不认识的身体里。

根据医生的说法，他是这个身体内形成的几个人格分裂中的第四个。

在大脑屈服于容纳这些多重身份的压力（导致所有身份永远消失）之前，Shii的任务是识别“原始人格”，以便他可以消除包括他自己在内的“虚假”人格。

Shii能否恢复他身体的真实人格呢？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11869]Novelgame[/url]]
